thread:
maria: quick ask — can someone run a short 'pulse' bench across A100 / H100 / L40s for rj-8b (seq=512) and capture p50/p99, tokens/s, nvidia-smi temps + nvlink stats? seeing intermittent p99 spikes on Dedicated this morning :thinking_face:

devon: I can spin this up on pool-3 tonight. which bench job template should I use?

maria: use bench/pulse-2026 (it's the lightweight one that runs 5k tokens per sku). config: model=redwood/rj-8b-quant, ctx=512, prompt len=256, batch sizes=1,4,8. capture nvidia-smi --query and nvlink stats (nvlink --stats) and perf counters if available. also note driver version.

ashok: heads-up — eu-west L40s are on driver 2.3.1 which had a power-cap/thermal change last month. call it out in the run metadata if you hit high temps.

devon: ok running now on pool-3 (A100,H100,L40s pinned). ETA ~45m. scheduling via ci-runner: bench/pulse-2026/2041239876.

ops-bot: bench job scheduled: bench/pulse-2026/2041239876 started on pool-3-worker-7 (A100) at 2041239980.

devon: quick raw results (first pass) — posting short sanitized table, numbers are median of 3 runs per sku, batch=1/4/8 aggregated in columns. will attach full logs to the ticket.

```
SKU    | p50_ms | p99_ms | tokens/s | avg_temp | nvlink_GB/s
A100   | 48     | 220    | 840      | 63C      | 12.1
H100   | 41     | 285    | 920      | 69C      | 17.8
L40s   | 52     | 175    | 760      | 71C      | 10.3
```

devon: notes — H100 throughput looks better but p99 worse than L40s in this config; nvlink utilization higher on H100 which hints at KV cache pressure; temps ok for A100/H100 but L40s trending higher. no obvious driver OOMs. attaching nvlink counters and nvidia-smi dumps to the job.

sam: :eyes: interesting that L40s p99 is lower. could be kernel fallback on H100 for certain sequence lengths, or scheduling jitter on A100 for microbatches.

maria: great — can you also run one targeted trace on H100 with seq=1024 and enable kernel debug counters (if not too noisy)? put results in the perf ticket and ping @ashok for driver cross-check.

devon: will do the seq=1024 trace after dinner, might need a maintenance window for debug counters.

ashok: I'll pull driver changelogs and check nvlink firmware versions across pools. if we see mismatch, that could explain throughput/p99 differences.

maria: thanks all. I'll open a perf ticket (INF-7421) with these results and assign to devon + ashok. quick wins: label the runs with driver+fw versions and include nvlink stats. tagging this thread for follow-up. :thumbsup:

devon: INF-7421 updated with full logs and raw traces (links in the ticket). closing this thread for now, will post follow-ups in the ticket.

ops-bot: bench job completed: bench/pulse-2026/2041239876 finished at 2041242560 (exit 0). artifacts uploaded to s3://bench-outputs/pulse/2041239876/

maria: perfect, thanks everyone.
